limitations: Core-service subtotal only: not an approved complete run estimate. Review applicable transfer, tax, existing-resource and other charges before execution.
Usage quantities are illustrative, not measured or hard quotas.

The 400000 SQS requests are a deliberately high two-hour planning scenario, not a service maximum or a measured poll count. The configured SQS event-source maximum concurrency disables Lambda's lowest-traffic polling optimization; measure actual requests during a live run.
Rates checked through AWS Price List API in us-east-1 with regionCode us-east-2 on 2026-10-18; storage uses paid tier rather than assuming a free allowance.
No Free Tier or credits subtracted.
No AI/model calls, NAT gateway, load balancer or provisioned concurrency included in this isolated stack.
Repeated runs and retained resources can exceed these quantities.
